---
title: "`r params$title`"
subtitle: "`r params$country`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 2
params:
  title: "ELSA results report"
  country: "Elsaland (example data)"
  actions: NULL
  pas: NULL
  regions: NULL
  region_col: NULL
  layers: NULL
  scheme: NULL
  pa_threshold: NULL
  target: 0.3
  protect_actions: NULL
  units: "ha"
  diagnostics: NULL
  sensitivity: NULL
  costs: NULL
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4, dpi = 150, out.width = "100%"
)
library(elsar)

p <- params
# With no inputs, render the bundled example so the template works out of the box
if (is.null(p$actions)) {
  ex <- elsar_example_results()
  p$actions <- ex$actions
  p$pas <- ex$pas
  p$regions <- ex$regions
  p$region_col <- "region_name"
}
scheme <- if (is.null(p$scheme)) elsar_action_scheme() else p$scheme

x <- if (isTRUE(try(elsar:::.is_prepared(p$actions), silent = TRUE))) {
  p$actions
} else {
  elsar_prepare_actions(p$actions, scheme = scheme, pas = p$pas, pa_threshold = p$pa_threshold)
}
has_pa <- "pa_fraction" %in% names(x)
has_regions <- !is.null(p$regions)
has_layers <- !is.null(p$layers)

national <- elsar_summarise_actions(x, units = p$units)
by_region <- if (has_regions) elsar_summarise_actions(x, p$regions, p$region_col, units = p$units)
main <- if (has_regions) by_region else national
# elsar_results_report() passes NA for "no target" (a NULL param would fall
# back to the default above)
if (length(p$target) == 0 || is.na(p$target)) p["target"] <- list(NULL)
has_target <- !is.null(p$target)
gap_national <- if (has_pa) {
  elsar_protection_gap(national, target = p$target, protect_actions = p$protect_actions)
}
# By region, with the true national row (regions can miss planning cells along
# borders), exactly as elsar_export_results() writes it
gap <- if (has_pa && has_regions) {
  elsar_protection_gap(by_region, target = p$target, protect_actions = p$protect_actions,
                       national = national)
} else {
  gap_national
}
overlap <- if (has_layers) elsar_summarise_overlap(x, p$layers, units = p$units)

unit_label <- c(ha = "ha", km2 = "km²", m2 = "m²")[[p$units]]
fmt_area <- function(v) paste(format(round(v), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), unit_label)
fmt_pct <- function(v, digits = 1) paste0(formatC(v, format = "f", digits = digits), "%")
kable <- function(d, ...) knitr::kable(d, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...)

planning_area <- sum(national$area)
action_area <- sum(national$area[national$is_action])

# A sub-action map has a parent action for each value
action_cats <- terra::cats(x[["action"]])[[1]]
has_sub <- "parent" %in% names(action_cats) && any(action_cats$parent != action_cats$label)
has_diagnostics <- has_sub && !is.null(p$diagnostics)
has_sensitivity <- has_sub && !is.null(p$sensitivity)
has_costs <- has_sub && !is.null(p$costs)
```

## Key figures

ELSA assigned an action to **`r fmt_pct(100 * action_area / planning_area)`** of
the planning area (`r fmt_area(action_area)` of `r fmt_area(planning_area)`).

```{r key-protection, results = "asis", eval = has_pa}
g <- gap_national
cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Existing protected areas cover **%s** of the planning area. ",
    "ELSA proposes a further **%s** of new protection, bringing the total to **%s**"
  ),
  fmt_pct(g$pct_current), fmt_pct(g$pct_new), fmt_pct(g$pct_total)
))
if (has_target) {
  cat(sprintf(" against a target of %s", fmt_pct(100 * p$target, 0)))
  cat(if (g$target_met) ": the target is met.\n" else
    sprintf(", leaving a gap of %s.\n", fmt_area(g$gap)))
} else {
  cat(".\n")
}
```

```{r national-map, fig.height = 6}
elsar_plot_actions(x, regions = p$regions)
```

```{r national-table}
national_tbl <- national[national$is_action, ]
tbl <- data.frame(
  Action = national_tbl$action,
  Area = round(national_tbl$area),
  `% of planning area` = round(national_tbl$pct_of_region, 1),
  check.names = FALSE
)
if (has_pa) {
  tbl$`In existing PAs` <- round(national_tbl$area_in_pa)
  tbl$`Outside existing PAs` <- round(national_tbl$area_outside_pa)
}
kable(tbl, caption = paste0("Area of each action (", unit_label, ")."))
```

```{r protection-heading, results = "asis", eval = has_pa}
    else "\n## Protection\n\n")
cat(
  "*Existing PAs* is all area inside existing protected areas. ",
  "*New protection* is area ELSA assigns to protection outside them.\n\n"
)
```

```{r protection-table, eval = has_pa}
  `Existing PAs (%)` = round(gap$pct_current, 1),
  `New protection (%)` = round(gap$pct_new, 1),
  `Total (%)` = round(gap$pct_total, 1),

)

kable(tbl, caption = paste0(
```

```{r sub-heading, results = "asis", eval = has_sub}
cat("\n## Sub-actions\n\n")
cat(
  "Each action is split into specific interventions by rules over context layers.",
  "Each cell goes to the first rule it meets, and cells that meet none go to a",
  "remaining sub-action, so the sub-actions of an action add up to its area.\n\n"
)
```

```{r sub-table, eval = has_sub}
sub_tbl <- national[national$is_action & national$group %in% action_cats$parent[action_cats$parent != action_cats$label], ]
parent_area <- tapply(sub_tbl$area, sub_tbl$group, sum)
gbf <- elsar_sub_action_catalogue()
tbl <- data.frame(
  Action = sub_tbl$group,
  `Sub-action` = sub_tbl$action,
  Area = round(sub_tbl$area),
  `% of action` = round(100 * sub_tbl$area / parent_area[sub_tbl$group], 1),
  check.names = FALSE
)
targets <- gbf$gbf_targets[match(as.character(sub_tbl$action), gbf$sub_action)]
if (any(!is.na(targets))) tbl$`GBF targets` <- ifelse(is.na(targets), "", targets)
kable(tbl, caption = paste0("Area of each sub-action (", unit_label, ").",
                            if (any(!is.na(targets))) " GBF targets of elsar's default sub-actions." else ""))
```

```{r sub-diagnostics-heading, results = "asis", eval = has_diagnostics}
cat("\n### How the rules split each action\n\n")
cat(
  "*Matched* is the area each rule's condition covers within its action;",
  "*assigned* is what it receives; *taken by an earlier rule* is the difference.",
  "A large remaining sub-action means the rules do not describe that action well.\n\n"
)
```

```{r sub-diagnostics, eval = has_diagnostics}
d <- p$diagnostics
kable(data.frame(
  Action = d$parent, `Sub-action` = d$sub_action,
  Condition = ifelse(is.na(d$condition), "(remaining cells)", d$condition),
  Matched = round(d$area_matched), Assigned = round(d$area_assigned),
  `Taken by an earlier rule` = round(d$area_shadowed),
  `% of action` = round(d$pct_of_parent, 1),
  check.names = FALSE
), caption = paste0("Rule diagnostics (",
                    c(ha = "ha", km2 = "km²", m2 = "m²")[[if (is.null(attr(d, "units"))) p$units else attr(d, "units")]],
                    ")."))
```

```{r sub-costs-calc, eval = has_costs}
cost <- elsar_cost_sub_actions(national, p$costs)
costed <- cost[!is.na(cost$cost_mid), ]
cur <- unique(stats::na.omit(cost$currency))
fmt_money <- function(v) paste(if (length(cur) == 1) cur else "", format(round(v), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE))
```

```{r sub-costs-heading, results = "asis", eval = has_costs}
cat("\n### Cost envelope\n\n")
cat(sprintf(
  paste0("Implementing the costed sub-actions would cost **%s to %s** (central estimate %s). ",
         "This multiplies each sub-action's area by unit costs per hectare from national ",
         "sources; it is a first budget envelope, not a costed plan."),
  fmt_money(sum(costed$cost_low)), fmt_money(sum(costed$cost_high)), fmt_money(sum(costed$cost_mid))
))
if (any(costed$per_year, na.rm = TRUE)) cat(" Some unit costs recur every year; their totals are for one year.")
missing <- setdiff(cost$sub_action, costed$sub_action)
if (length(missing) > 0) cat(paste0(" Without unit costs: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "."))
cat("\n\n")
```

```{r sub-costs-plot, eval = has_costs, fig.height = 4.5}
elsar_plot_costs(cost)
```

```{r sub-costs-table, eval = has_costs}
  `Area (ha)` = round(costed$area_ha),
  Low = round(costed$cost_low), Central = round(costed$cost_mid), High = round(costed$cost_high),
  check.names = FALSE
), caption = paste0("Cost envelope", if (length(cur) == 1) paste0(" (", cur, ")") else "", "."))
```

```{r region-profiles, results = "asis", eval = has_regions, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
cat("\n## Regional profiles\n\n")
for (r in levels(by_region$region)) {
  s <- by_region[by_region$region == r, ]
  top <- s[s$is_action, ][which.max(s$area[s$is_action]), ]
  cat("\n### ", r, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf(
    "ELSA assigns an action to %s of the planning area. The largest is %s (%s).",
    fmt_pct(sum(s$pct_of_region[s$is_action])), top$action, fmt_area(top$area)
  ))
  if (has_pa) {
    g <- gap[gap$region == r, ]
    cat(sprintf(" Protection rises from %s to %s.", fmt_pct(g$pct_current), fmt_pct(g$pct_total)))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
  print(elsar_plot_region(x, by_region, p$regions, p$region_col, r, title = NULL))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Methods

* Areas are calculated from the ELSA action map with
  `elsar_summarise_actions()`. Cell areas are planar in the equal-area
  projection used by ELSA (geodesic for longitude/latitude rasters), and cells
  cut by a region boundary are weighted by the share inside the region.
* Percentages are of the *planning area*: all cells with an ELSA value,
  including cells with no action.
`r if (has_pa) "* Protected-area cover is used as a fraction of each cell, unless a threshold was set. When protected areas are locked into Protect, *existing PAs* are Protect cells inside them and *new protection* is Protect outside them."`
